title: Single-Cell Multiple Displacement Amplification \(SCMDA)
protocol: Isolate single cells and deposit into 0.2-ml PCR tubes containing 2.5 μl PBS.
Place the tubes on dry ice and store at -80°C.
Add 1 μl exo-resistant random primers to the PCR tube.
Add 3 μl lysis buffer to the PCR tube.
Flick the mixture several times.
Spin down the mixture quickly.
Keep the mixture on ice for 10 min.
Add 3 μl stop buffer to neutralize the lysis buffer.
Keep the neutralized solution on ice for 2 min.
Add 32 μl of master mix containing MDA reaction buffer and Phi29 polymerase.
Mix by pipetting gently.
Incubate at 30°C for 1.5 hr.
Incubate at 65°C for 3 min.
Purify amplified product with 75.6 μl AMPureXP-beads.
Mix the beads and purified product by pipetting.
Leave the mixture at room temperature for 5 min.
Place the mixture on a magnetic separator until clear.
Remove the clear liquid by pipetting.
Wash beads twice with fresh 80% ethanol.
Air-dry beads for about 5 min to avoid cracking.
Elute beads using 32 μl nuclease-free water.
Put back the tube to magnetic separator and keep it at room temperature for 5 min until the solution is clear and a pellet is formed again.
Transfer 30 µl clear liquid from the tube to a clean tube.
Store the purified product at 4°C for short-term storage or -20°C for long-term storage.
Dilute the purified product 10-20 times and quantify the samples using Qubit.
Check the product size by agarose gel electrophoresis using 1.0% agarose gel, 1.0% TBE solution, and incubate at 100V for 40 min.
Dilute the purified product and unamplified genomic DNA to 1 ng/µl using nuclease-free water.
Prepare a 96-well plate with PCR mixture including 5 µl Fast Sybr green master mix, 1 µl locus-specific primers, 2 µl nuclease-free water, and 2 µl diluted DNA for each well.
Seal the plate and spin down.
Incubate under qPCR program: 95°C for 20s, followed by 40 cycles at 95°C for 3 s and 60°C for 30 s.
Calculate the relative uniformity values (RUVs) for 8 loci.
Select samples with RUV values of at least 6 of the 8 loci between 0.25-4 for library construction.
